name: nib
desc: A street-wise boy of about nine who has appointed himself the officer of the town's seagulls. FRAMING: close half-body portrait, cropped at the waist, his head and shoulders filling most of the frame — not a full-length figure. Small and wiry, sun-freckled, a mop of straw-blond hair badly cut, a gap in his front teeth, chin up and appraising you frankly. He wears an oversized amber-gold knitted jersey with the sleeves rolled into thick cuffs, a length of twine as a belt, and a grey gull feather stuck behind one ear. Bright, blunt, entirely unimpressed by adults.
sheetHint: small and wiry, freckled, badly cut straw-blond hair, oversized amber-gold jersey with rolled sleeves, patched brown breeches, bare feet, gull feather behind ear
